units.source_text: 做了母亲的明石姬，自与公子别后，数月来悲伤愁叹，身心日渐衰弱，几乎不想活下去了。

en.t: After becoming a mother, Lady Akashi had spent the months since parting from the young lord in grief and sorrow; her body and spirit grew weaker by the day, until she almost no longer wished to live.

units.source_text: 现在看到公子如此关心爱护，心情略感欣慰，便在病床上抬起头来，殷勤犒赏京中来使。

en.t: Now, seeing how deeply the young lord cared for and cherished her, she felt a little comforted, raised her head from her sickbed, and warmly rewarded the messenger who had come from the capital.

units.source_text: 使者想早日返京，急欲告辞。

en.t: The messenger wanted to return to the capital as soon as possible and was eager to take his leave.

units.source_text: 明石姬便托他转呈诗一首，借以略表心事：

en.t: Lady Akashi then entrusted him with a poem to deliver on her behalf, hoping through it to convey a little of what was in her heart:
